adaptationPolicy: Fossil bytes were identical at every runnable revision. No import was rewritten and no assertion was weakened to obtain a result.
crossRevisionSetup: Detached git worktrees with node_modules symlinked from the 6b09 checkout. Workspace packages resolve through tsconfig paths / the vitest alias at ./packages, so each worktree used its own workspace sources. packages/normalization-core and packages/retry are byte-identical across 6b09, 530b33e and ab5b8b9, so the symlink cannot have changed behavior. Worktrees were removed after the runs.

verdict.statement: The bypass is original to the turn-adoption lifecycle seam (16c14e5bbfc9, upstream, 2026-07-16) and is unchanged in the absorbed upstream base, the deployed composite, and current upstream main. 06600e2ca09 refactored the unconditional release into releaseUnadopted and added a test that pins the behavior; it did not introduce the bypass. 69983f80113 made pre-adoption failures hand back to durable ingress, which is what turned an unbounded loop into the observed 42-attempt capped-cadence retry storm rather than a stranded claim.
